Accordion.name: Accordion
Accordion.description: A collapsible content panel for organizing information in a compact space

allowsMultipleExpanded.name: allowsMultipleExpanded
allowsMultipleExpanded.description: Whether multiple items can be expanded at once

onExpandedChange.name: onExpandedChange
onExpandedChange.description: Handler called when expanded keys change

isDisabled.name: isDisabled
isDisabled.description: Whether the entire accordion is disabled

variant.name: variant
variant.description: The visual variant of the accordion

Avatar.name: Avatar
Avatar.description: Display user profile images with customizable fallback content

srcSet.name: srcSet
srcSet.description: The image `srcset` attribute for responsive images

sizes.name: sizes
sizes.description: The image `sizes` attribute for responsive images

onLoad.name: onLoad
onLoad.description: Callback when the image loads successfully

onError.name: onError
onError.description: Callback when there's an error loading the image

ignoreFallback.name: ignoreFallback
ignoreFallback.description: If `true`, opt out of the fallback logic and use as regular `img`

shouldBypassImageLoad.name: shouldBypassImageLoad
shouldBypassImageLoad.description: If `true`, image load will be bypassed and handled by `asChild` component

crossOrigin.name: crossOrigin
crossOrigin.description: CORS setting for the image request

Button.name: Button
Button.description: A clickable button component with multiple variants and states

isPending.name: isPending
isPending.description: Whether the button is in a loading state

isIconOnly.name: isIconOnly
isIconOnly.description: Whether the button contains only an icon

onPress.name: onPress
onPress.description: Handler called when the button is pressed

Card.name: Card
Card.description: A flexible container component for displaying content with multiple layout variants and surface levels

variant.name: variant
variant.description: Layout variant for different card styles

surface.name: surface
surface.description: Surface elevation level for visual hierarchy

asChild.name: asChild
asChild.description: Render as a child element (default: h3)

asChild.name: asChild
asChild.description: Render as a child element (default: p)

asChild.name: asChild
asChild.description: Render as a child element (default: img)

onPress.name: onPress
onPress.description: Handler called when button is pressed

Chip.name: Chip
Chip.description: Small informational badges for displaying labels, statuses, and categories

children.name: children
children.description: Content to display inside the chip

DisclosureGroup.name: DisclosureGroup
DisclosureGroup.description: Container that manages multiple Disclosure items with coordinated expanded states

onExpandedChange.name: onExpandedChange
onExpandedChange.description: Handler called when expanded items change

allowsMultipleExpanded.name: allowsMultipleExpanded
allowsMultipleExpanded.description: Whether multiple items can be expanded simultaneously

isDisabled.name: isDisabled
isDisabled.description: Whether all disclosures in the group are disabled

examples:
import {DisclosureGroup, Disclosure} from '@heroui/react';

export default () => (
  <DisclosureGroup>
    <Disclosure id="item1">
      <Disclosure.Heading>
        <Disclosure.Trigger>
          <Disclosure.Indicator />
        </Disclosure.Trigger>
      </Disclosure.Heading>
      <Disclosure.Content />
    </Disclosure>
  </DisclosureGroup>
)

Disclosure.name: Disclosure
Disclosure.description: A disclosure is a collapsible section with a header containing a heading and a trigger button, and a panel that wraps the content.

Kbd.name: Kbd
Kbd.description: Display keyboard shortcuts and key combinations

keyValue.name: keyValue
keyValue.description: The keyboard key to display. Available values include modifier keys and special keys

Link.name: Link
Link.description: A styled anchor component for navigation with built-in icon support

target.name: target
target.description: Specifies where to open the linked document

onPress.name: onPress
onPress.description: Handler called when the link is pressed

autoFocus.name: autoFocus
autoFocus.description: Whether the element should receive focus on render

Popover.name: Popover
Popover.description: Displays rich content in a portal triggered by a button or any custom element

children.name: children
children.description: Content to display in the popover

shouldFlip.name: shouldFlip
shouldFlip.description: Whether popover can change orientation to fit

Separator.name: Separator

animationType.description: The animation type for the skeleton. Can be globally configured via `--skeleton-default-animation-type` CSS variable

Spinner.name: Spinner
Spinner.description: A loading indicator component to show pending states

Switch.name: Switch

defaultSelected.name: defaultSelected

name.name: name
name.description: The name of the input element, used when submitting an HTML form

value.name: value

onChange.name: onChange
onChange.description: Handler called when the switch value changes

onPress.name: onPress

orientation.name: orientation

Tabs.name: Tabs
Tabs.description: Tabs organize content into multiple sections and allow users to navigate between them.
examples:
import { Tabs } from '@heroui/react';

export default () => (
  <Tabs>
    <Tabs.ListWrapper>
      <Tabs.List aria-label="Options">
        <Tabs.Tab/>
      </Tabs.List>
      <Tabs.Indicator />
    </Tabs.ListWrapper>
    <Tabs.Panel/>
  </Tabs>
)

TextField.name: TextField
TextField.description: Text input fields for forms with labels, descriptions, and error messages
examples:
import { TextField } from '@heroui/react';

export default () => (
  <TextField>
    <TextField.Label>Field label</TextField.Label>
    <TextField.Input placeholder="Enter value" />
    <TextField.Description>
      Helper text for the field
    </TextField.Description>
    <TextField.Error>
      Error message when invalid
    </TextField.Error>
  </TextField>
)

Tooltip.name: Tooltip
Tooltip.description: Displays informative text when users hover over or focus on an element

delay.name: delay
delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before showing tooltip

closeDelay.name: closeDelay
closeDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before hiding tooltip

children.name: children
children.description: Content to display in the tooltip

showArrow.name: showArrow
showArrow.description: Whether to show the arrow indicator

examples:
import { Tooltip } from '@heroui/react';

export default () => (
  <Tooltip>
    <Tooltip.Trigger>
      <button>Hover for tooltip</button>
    </Tooltip.Trigger>
    <Tooltip.Content>
      <Tooltip.Arrow />
      Helpful information about this element
    </Tooltip.Content>
  </Tooltip>
)
